title: Whirlbash
blueprint: A 3D spinning-top arena brawler in the io style: you and 11 rival bot tops share a bowl-shaped stadium ringed by bumper walls with three open pits. Collect sparks to grow your spin (spin is both health and size), dash into rivals to drain their spin, and shove them into the pits for big ring-out points while arena events (Spark Storm, Arena Tilt, Overdrive) shake things up; gears earned per run unlock crown, core, tip and paint parts in the Garage. Controls: WASD/arrows or mouse to steer, Space or click to dash, P to pause; touch uses a floating joystick and a dash button. A midgame ad plays only when starting a new run from the results screen; an optional rewarded ad doubles the gears earned on the results screen.
description: Spin up your top and battle 11 rival tops in a glowing night stadium! Grab sparks to grow bigger, dash into rivals to drain their spin, and knock them into the three open pits for a ring out. Watch out for Spark Storms, Arena Tilts and Overdrive, take down the #1 top for double points, and spend your gears in the Garage on new crowns, cores, tips and paints that change how your top fights.

controls.desktop: WASD / Arrow keys or move the mouse to steer. Space or left click: dash. P: pause.
controls.mobile: Drag anywhere to steer with the floating joystick. Tap the bolt button to dash.

ads.midgame: Only when the player taps 'Play again' on the results screen (between runs; the SDK caps it at one every 3 minutes)
ads.rewarded: Optional 'Double gears' button on the results screen, once per run; hidden when ads are unavailable or fail

quality.hook: Compared with Spinner.io, Attack.IO Spins Battle and Super Spinners (endless open arenas where you only grow and bump), Whirlbash is about positioning: the stadium has bumper walls and three open pits, so the best plays are ring-outs where you shove a rival into a pit, rival bots hunt from the side away from the pit, timed arena events (Spark Storm, Arena Tilt that slides everyone toward one pit, Overdrive) change the fight every 40 seconds, and the #1 top carries a double-points bounty.
quality.onboarding: The first run is a guided tutorial inside real gameplay: four coach cards with key or gesture icons and at most six words each (move, grab the highlighted ring of sparks, dash into a practice top, push rivals toward the pits, with floor chevrons pointing at the nearest pit). Rival bots stay passive and your spin does not decay until it ends, and a Skip button is always visible.
quality.art_style: One procedural look: glossy toy-plastic tops built in Three.js from crown, core and tip parts in eight saturated paints, a cobalt bowl stadium with coral/cream bumper walls and hazard-striped pits, a night-indigo sky with light beams and a boxy crowd. The UI uses Lilita One titles, Nunito text and flat inline SVG icons in the same palette. Covers are rendered from the game itself, so the cover, menu and gameplay all match.
quality.content: Endless io-style runs against 11 bots of four skill and aggression levels that respawn bigger as the run goes on; bot aggression ramps over two minutes; three rotating arena events every ~38 seconds; a leaderboard with the #1 crown and bounty; 16 garage items (4 crowns, 4 cores, 4 tips with real stat trade-offs plus 8 paints) unlocked with gears (about 5 to 10 runs for the first unlocks, 30+ for everything); best score saved.
quality.name_check: 'Whirlbash' is an invented word (whirl + bash) that says spinning and smashing. A web search found no game with that name, it uses no words from the spinning-top toy franchises, and it does not read as a plain genre label.
quality.visual_review: Checked menu, gameplay (1216x684 and 800x450 touch), standalone build and all three covers at full size. Fixed: empty leaderboard during the countdown, tutorial coach appearing before the countdown ended, a grey smudge from the floor emblem, bot names too small at 800x450, score and knockout icons looking alike, and a blown-out white blob in the cover clash plus oversized foreground sparks. No T-poses (all tops are procedural and always spinning), no overlapping UI text (every screen sits on an opaque card), and the covers are rendered in-engine so they match the gameplay.

press.headline: {studio} launches Whirlbash, a spinning-top arena brawler playable instantly in the browser
press.summary: Whirlbash drops players into a glowing night stadium with 11 rival spinning tops. Grab sparks to grow, dash to clash, and knock rivals into the open pits for a ring out, while arena events like Spark Storm and Arena Tilt keep every round unpredictable. It runs instantly in any modern browser on desktop and mobile, with no download or account required.
features: Physics clashes: spin is your health and your size, and every hit drains it
Ring-outs: shove rivals into three open pits for the biggest points
Arena events every 40 seconds: Spark Storm, Arena Tilt and Overdrive
Hunt the #1 top for a double-points bounty
Garage with 16 parts and paints that change attack, defense, stamina and speed
Plays with keyboard, mouse or touch, in English and Turkish
press.quote: We wanted the thrill of two tops grinding against each other at full speed, and the pits turn every clash into a decision: push now, or wait for the angle.
